integrity: The standalone Python checker enumerates and cross-checks all vertex subsets, validates acyclic Hasse matchings and exact integral Morse attaching-degree matrices. The review is not independent verification.
scientific_limitations: The assertions concern only GP(6,2), cutoffs 1, 2 and 3, and their two successive inclusion maps. All discrete-Morse and matrix computations are exact and exhaustive for the specified finite cases; a general higher-cutoff or generalized-Petersen classification is not claimed. An unindexed equivalent earlier result is possible.
title: Integral higher-independence homotopy of the Dürer graph through cutoff three
